name: Intra Balance Movement Posting Report V 02
definition: This IntraBalanceMovementPostingReport message is sent from a settlement infrastructure to an account owner/requestor to report the intra-balance movement instructions, previously sent by the account owner, that have a settled status.||The message may also be used to: |-	- re-send a message sent by the account owner to the account servicer (the sub-function of the message is "Duplicate") |-	- provide a third party with a copy of a message being sent by the account owner for information (the sub-function of the message is "Copy") |-	- re-send to a third party a copy of a message being sent by the account owner for information (the sub-function of the message is "Copy Duplicate").

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the message as known by the account servicer or settlement infrastructure.

ReportGeneralDetails.name: Report General Details
ReportGeneralDetails.definition: General characteristics related to the report information.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account to or from which a cash entry is made.

CashAccountServicer.name: Cash Account Servicer
CashAccountServicer.definition: Party that manages the cash account on behalf of the account owner, that is manages the registration and booking of entries on the account, calculates balances on the account and provides information about the account.

ActivityIndicatorYesRule.definition: If ActivityIndicator is equal to Yes (true or 1) then SubBalances must be present.

ActivityIndicatorNoRule.definition: If ActivityIndicator is equal to No (false or 0) then SubBalances must be absent.
